fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f1 (contradiction on role-prompts-scoped-tests): Says every check, critic and fixer prompt of the builtin review workflow carries the scoped-tests rule (and its internal/workflow test asserts it), but leaf review-prompts-one-line makes those prompts one line with no test-scope text. The plan updates neither this node nor its acceptance, so the built change contradicts the model and fails that test; update it to say the prompts reach the rule through their topics (the shared test-scope block). The critic confirmed it: role-prompts-scoped-tests says every check, critic and fixer prompt of the builtin review workflow carries the scoped-tests rule, and internal/workflow/workflow_test.go:1556 asserts it; leaf review-prompts-one-line's acceptance requires check prompts with no test-scope text and critic/fixer prompts equal to one-line forms without it. No plan change set updates the node, so the landed acceptance fails. Major stands. How should it be settled?

Plan review round 3 left finding f2 (contradiction on guides-scoped-tests): Says the review guide topic (and the rhiza-review skill) states the scoped-tests rule for checks, critics and fixers, asserted by TestReviewText on review.md; the plan turns review into a short index and moves the rule into the check-*/critic/fixer topics via the shared test-scope block, but leaves this node unchanged. Update it to name the role topics. The critic confirmed it: guides-scoped-tests' acceptance has TestReviewText assert review.md states the rule for checks, critics and fixers (review_test.go 'scoped-tests' phrases); the plan cuts review.md to an index and leaves this node unchanged. Major stands. How should it be settled?

Plan review round 3 left finding f3 (contradiction on command-budget-guide): Acceptance asserts review.md holds the command budget rule; under the plan review.md becomes an index and the rule lives in the shared command-budget block expanded into the role topics. Node not updated by the plan. The critic confirmed it: command-budget-guide's acceptance asserts review.md holds the budget rule (budget_test.go loops over build and review); under the plan review.md is an index and the rule moves to the shared command-budget block in role topics. Node not updated. Major stands. How should it be settled?

Plan review round 3 left finding f4 (contradiction on unstable-ci-guidance): Says the rhiza-review guide topic carries the unstable-CI reproduce-locally rule (TestReviewText finds it in review.md); the plan moves it to the shared unstable-CI block in fixer, ci-fix and gate-fix and makes review an index, without updating this node. The critic confirmed it: unstable-ci-guidance's acceptance finds the unstable-CI rule in the rhiza-review text via TestReviewText (review_test.go 'unstable-ci'); the plan moves it to the fixer/ci-fix/gate-fix topics' shared block and leaves this node naming the review topic. Major stands. How should it be settled?

Plan review round 3 left finding f5 (contradiction on done-own-command-guide): Acceptance asserts review.md holds the session-done own-command rule; the plan moves it into the shared done block of the role topics and the one-line prompts drop session-done text, leaving review.md an index. Node not updated. The critic confirmed it: done-own-command-guide's acceptance asserts review.md holds the own-command rule (review_test.go 'done'); the plan moves session-done into the role topics' shared done block and review.md becomes an index. Node not updated. Major stands. How should it be settled?

Plan review round 3 left finding f6 (contradiction on guides-stdin-findings): Says the review guide shows rhiza run findings/verdict fed by heredoc (asserted in review_test.go); under the plan those heredocs live in check-* and critic topics and review is an index. Node not updated to name the role topics. Plan review round 3 left finding f7 (contradiction on guides-one-final-paragraph): Says the review guide's fixer instruction shows all trailers in one final paragraph; the plan moves the fixer instruction to the fixer (and ci-fix, gate-fix, conflict-fix) topics, leaving review an index. Plan review round 3 left finding f8 (contradiction on delay-repro-guidance): Says the rhiza-review guide topic tells checks and fixers to reproduce a timing flake by injecting a delay; the plan empties review.md into an index and does not say which role topic (fixer, ci-fix, gate-fix, check-quality) carries this rule, nor update this node. The critic confirmed it: delay-repro-guidance's acceptance finds the delay-injection rule in the review topic via TestReviewText ('delay-repro'); review.md becomes an index, and no plan leaf's acceptance (fixer, ci-fix, gate-fix, check-quality) names the delay rule, so the rule is either lost or the landed acceptance fails.
